cleanup.notes: Setup (npm ci in tests/) creates tests/node_modules; the optional dev setup (npm ci in starter/) creates starter/node_modules. Cleanup deletes both; the tests create nothing else. The tests stub fetch and never use the network; the dev server serves a local mock API from mock-api.js. Resetting the learner's work means restoring starter/src from a fresh copy of the lab. The expected output file writes variable timings as <ms>, and test file lines may print in any order. The 25-minute median and 30-minute cap are planning figures for the module's guided lab slot, not a measured learner pilot. Setup (the one-time npm ci) completes before the lab slot's working time; the 30-minute allowance covers only work on the tasks. All assertions are behavioral through Testing Library against rendered output plus the shipped render-count diagnostic; no test reads the learner's source text. Partial-objective note: navigation#o2's replacing-the-history-entry clause, loading-data-with-useeffect#o2's what-an-empty-dependency-array-means clause, loading-data-with-useeffect#o3's Strict-Mode-explanation clause, and what-makes-a-component-re-render#o3's predict-the-re-render and describe-memo clauses are not lab-tested; all are practised on their topic pages, not in this lab.
